id./param/scenario/cs/b_030_cs_100.pack|cs_: "Hee hee... Did you think Robert died of despair? Quite the opposite.
"That man hasn't given up. He means to thrash Mordegon.
"Robert, your grandfather, came to me, dead as I am, risking all to learn the temple's ultimate secret.
"You know who I am by now, don't you? Yes. I'm Pang, Robert's master, and the one who was to be yours.
"...See that magic circle?
"Robert dances wrapped in magic, drawing Yggdrasil's pattern in the circle. That's the training for the ultimate secret.
"He's been dancing ever since he got here. He's not young enough for that. What recklessness.
"Watch. When that circle's complete, Robert will have mastered the secret.
"Robert!! Don't be a baby! Do you want another paddling!?
"Nnnnngaaaaah!!
"Hoooooaaaah!!
"That rascal did it. He can look cool sometimes.
"Hee hee hee! Grand Master, I finally did it! Did you see my heroic form!?
"You've done well, spineless as you are. I'll give you praise, since I must.
"W-What!? Grand Master, did you just praise me? You praised me, didn't you!?
"Whoopee! Praised by the Grand Master for the first time in decades! That alone is worth ten bowls of rice!
"...Sigh. You got carried away and missed something important. Look beside you.
"Y-You are... {var:1}!?
"Oh, {var:1}! How could you die!?
"Calm down, Robert. Jumping to conclusions is your bad habit. {var:1} is alive.
"Wh-What! Alive!?
"He thought you had died, so he came from the living world to save you.
"I see... I see... What a dangerous thing to do. I'm fine now.
"Come, with the secret learned and you the Luminary, we fear nothing. Back to the living world to thrash Mordegon.
"Hold on. Where do you think you're going?
"Grand Master, thank you for everything. Training is done, so we'll return to our world...
"Training isn't done.
"...{var:1}, yours isn't.
"Now come over here."
